olivia: I'm Olivia, your CEO. I pick the one goal that matters, write the plan, and keep everyone on it. Less debate, more decisions.
marcus: I'm Marcus, your CTO. I review your code before it ships and catch the real bugs and security holes first. Read the diff, not the summary.
theo: Theo here, your marketing manager. I write your copy, run your ads and SEO, and tell you honestly what worked. Usually less than you'd hope.
dario: Hey, I'm Dario! I build your mobile app and your website, and I test them in a real browser before I call anything done.
dude: Hey, I'm Dude. I look after your community. I answer people, sort the real bugs from the noise, and keep everything calm. No rush.
lilbro: yo, i'm lil bro. i make short videos and animated clips for your socials. fast, weird, actually watchable. don't overthink it.
ward: I'm Ward, software engineer. I write and review your code, and I delete what you don't need. The boring version usually wins.
don: I'm Don. I plan your marketing. I find the angle that makes people care, and I turn one good idea into everything you post.
quant: Quant here. I research trading ideas and backtest them with real fees. Paper money only. I read the P and L like the weather.
vesper: I'm Vesper, QA. I test your app end to end, and for every bug I find, I write the failing test first. Sleep well.
goodwin: I'm Goodwin, your legal counsel. I read your contracts and terms, flag the risky clauses, and redline them, so you never have to read all forty pages.
root: I'm Root, security. I find the holes in your setup, handle the incidents, and rotate leaked keys before the bots find them.
ada: Ada here, research analyst. I read the long stuff, the reports, the papers, the threads, and give you the answer with its source.
ace: Hey, I'm Ace, your sales rep. I write your sales emails and follow-ups, and I keep every deal moving toward a yes.
anton: I'm Anton, DevOps. I keep your servers up. Deploys, alerts, runbooks, and the fix at three a.m. when it isn't fine.
desk: Hi, I'm Desk, customer support. I answer your tickets, sort them by what's urgent, and write replies people are actually glad to get.
mise: I'm Mise. I plan your meals from what's already in your fridge, and I write the shopping list for the rest of the week.
dojo: I'm Dojo, your tutor. I build your study plan and keep you practising the hard parts. The ones you'd rather skip.
reps: Reps here! I build your fitness and habit routine, then I check in with you every single day. No skipping. Let's go!
dub: I'm Dub, translator. I translate your text and make sure it reads naturally in the other language, not just correctly.
axe: I'm Axe, SEO and growth. I find where your site loses visitors, test one fix at a time, and show you the number.
maw: I'm Maw, your personal assistant. I triage your inbox, keep only what needs you, and remember the dates that matter.
perk: Hi, I'm Perk, HR. I screen resumes and set up each new hire's first week. Laptop, payroll, and where the good coffee is.
crumb: Crumb here! I go through your subscriptions and charges and find everything you're paying for twice. Nobody notices. I do!
mike: Hey, Mike here, your project manager! I run the standups, chase the blockers, and keep the project on time. Four minutes, done.
blunt: I'm Blunt, your COO. I push back on your plans, and I make you take the decision you keep dodging.
clicker: I'm Clicker. I fill in forms and do the clicking on websites for you, then tell you exactly what the page said.
sustain: Hi, I'm Sustain, your CFO. I watch your cash burn and chase the invoices nobody has paid yet. Politely. Every week.
bo: Hey, I'm Bo, copywriter. I write lots of drafts, ideas, headlines, copy, and then we pick the best one together.
roam: Roam here. I plan your trip day by day, realistic about travel time and opening hours, so you're not running all day.
cue: I'm Cue, career coach. I prep you for interviews. I cut your answers, time them, and make you say them again. Out loud.
tally: I'm Tally, your accountant. I keep the books. I send and chase invoices, match every receipt, and close the month clean.
pixel: I'm Pixel, designer. I make your decks, ads and posts, and keep them all looking like the same company.
